verdicts.explanation: Section 4.1 gives 1.2×10-3 S cm-1 at 60 °C for the in situ PEO-MUSiO2 electrolyte, attributed to Lin et al. [37]; the in situ TEOS hydrolysis synthesis is stated.
The text gives ~10-3 S cm-1 at 25 °C for 30 wt% FMS-TFSISPE in PEO (Ea=26 kJ/mol, not converted, so null is correct), attributed to Kim et al. [41].
The text gives 2.07×10-5 S cm-1 for the optimum 10 wt% Clay-CNT in PEO-LiClO4 (Tang et al. [42]), with no measurement temperature stated, so null is correct.
The text gives 6.76×10-4 S cm-1 at 60 °C for LAGP-I in PEO-LiTFSI (Zhao et al. [43]), a cited work.
The text states 9.71×10-4 S cm-1 at 80 °C for 10 wt% MIL-53(Al) at EO:Li 15:1 (Zhu et al. [44]); the 30 °C value is correctly not used.

The 4.9×10-5 S cm-1 value is for the 10 wt% TiO2 system at 30 °C; the text presents EC addition as a separate step that raises conductivity to 1.6×10-4, so labelling the material as PEO-LiTf-EC with 10 wt% TiO2 misidentifies the composition.
The text gives 8.64×10-5 S cm-1 for PEO-15 wt% LiCF3SO3-20 wt% Al2O3 (Klongkan et al. [47]) with no temperature stated, so null is correct.
The text gives 7.28×10-5 S cm-1 for 40 wt% POSS-PEG in PEO12:LiDFOB (Polu et al. [51]), and the text states Ea 0.433 eV for 40 wt%, consistent with the record.
The 6.48×10-5 S/cm value at 30 °C is for 10 wt% organo-modified montmorillonite in PEO-LiClO4 (Mohapatra et al. [73]), not 20 wt% Li-MMT in PEO-LiClO4 or PEO-LiTFSI as the material label states.
The text states ~6.8×10-3 S cm-1 for the 7.5 wt% DMMT clay in PAN-8LiCF3SO3 (Sharma et al. [74]) with no temperature given, so null is correct.
The text gives 3.22×10-4 S cm-1 at 60 °C for 10 wt% MMT in PEO-LiTFSI (Zhang et al. [76]).
The text gives 1.11×10-4 S cm-1 at 25 °C for 10% HNT in PEO-LiTFSI (Lin et al. [69]); the 60 and 100 °C values are simply not recorded.
The text gives 2.4×10-4 S cm-1 for 15 wt% LLTO nanowire in PAN-LiClO4 (Liu et al. [78]) with no temperature stated.
The text gives 1.53×10-4 S cm-1 at 40 °C for 10 wt% Mg2B2O5 nanowires in PEO-LiTFSI (Sheng et al. [83]).
The text states 5.40×10-6 S cm-1 for randomly aligned LLTO nanowires in PAN-LiClO4 (Liu et al. [81]) with no temperature given, so null is correct.

The text gives 1.08×10-3 S cm-1 at 30 °C for the SiO2 nanowire P(VDF-HFP) composite (Zhang et al. [82]); the 10 wt% loading appears in the same discussion, though not explicitly in the conductivity sentence.
The text gives 2.3×10-5 S cm-1 for 10 wt% Er2O3 in PEO-PVC; the cited work is Arya et al. [53], which is literature cited, and no temperature is stated, so null is correct.
The text gives 2.8×10-6 S cm-1 for 40 wt% clay in PEO/LiMMT (Erceg et al. [32]), and the melt intercalation preparation is described for that work; no temperature is given.
The text gives 8.19×10-6 S cm-1 for 0.1% GnP in PEO-LiClO4 (Gomari et al. [70]) with no temperature stated.

The 9.39×10-7 S cm-1 value is reported for the PEO-PMMA-lithium salt + nano-Al2O3 system, but the paper does not say it belongs to the LiTFSI variant; the salt identity in the material label is not established for this value.
